en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a mountainous alpine landscape with dramatic rocky peaks partly covered in snow, labeled with peak names at the top. At the bottom of the valley sits a small settlement with hotels and a church-like building surrounded by trees and fields. There is printed Italian captioning at the bottom and handwritten Italian text across the lower margin and upper right corner.
